test: TC-AI-001: Failure Explainer diagnoses UI selector failure with DOM snapshot and suggests code fix

diagnosis.rootCauseSummary: Target locator '#welcome-banner' was not found or visible within 5000ms timeout.
diagnosis.plainEnglishExplanation: The page did not transition to the authenticated welcome view because credentials failed, leaving an error alert visible in the DOM.
diagnosis.suggestedFix: Verify login credentials or await the error alert '#alert-error' instead of '#welcome-banner' when testing invalid submissions.

test: TC-AI-002: Failure Explainer diagnoses API 403 Forbidden permission mismatch and suggests header/role fix

diagnosis.rootCauseSummary: User authenticated with Viewer role attempted an operation requiring Admin permissions.
diagnosis.plainEnglishExplanation: The API endpoint rejected the DELETE request with HTTP 403 Forbidden because 'valid-token-viewer' lacks administrative permissions.
diagnosis.suggestedFix: Supply an Admin Bearer token (e.g., 'valid-token-admin') in the Authorization header before issuing DELETE /api/v1/test-runs/:id.
